backfillRows.why: AoN feat-7980 (Arcana of Iron, Battlecry! pg. 82): "The extra damage you deal with Bespell Strikes increases to 1d8." The clause reached nothing on the record - Bespell Strikes (feat-5028) deals "an extra 1d6 force damage" only in prose, so the upgrade had no number-carrying lane either. `situational` is the lane the reader already exists for: explain.ts's take() walk over c.feats (src/rules/explain.ts:583) files the clause under the feat's id and it surfaces as a star in the strike-damage breakdown, which is where the player needs it. Not a flat strikeDamage bonus: it applies only after a non-cantrip spell, once per turn, on one weapon - a number would be wrong on every other Strike. Existing overlay rows for this record are grantsClassFeatures only, so no supersedes.

findings.note: One situational row on the upgrade feat. The base Bespell Strikes 1d6 has no carrier either; starring the UPGRADE alone would be misleading, so the `bonus` text states the replacement (1d8 instead of 1d6) rather than a delta.

backfillRows.why: AoN equipment-4028 (Astrolabe of Falling Stars): "An astrolabe of falling stars can be used as a mariner's astrolabe", and the base astrolabe (equipment-4027) prints "An astrolabe also grants a +1 item bonus to checks to identify celestial bodies" with NO skill named. Byte-identical in shape and wording to the shipped `astrolabe` entry in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:2995 and its five siblings (astrolabe-standard, astrolabe-mariners, standard-astrolabe, mariners-astrolabe, aon-astrolabe) - all on skill/all, not narrowed to Survival as WG does (owner 2026-09-10 #51). Authored as DATA rather than a code entry because this chunk may not edit src/: the reader is the item walk at src/rules/explain.ts:552, gated on itemInUse, which is the same channel the code table feeds. Existing overlay rows for this record are `frequency` only, so no supersedes. VERIFIER (b037 data-rows-6): `whileCarried: true` added, or the clause is unreachable. `itemInUse` needs worn/invested/equipped/attachedTo (derive.ts:278), and an itemType `equipment` record with no `invested` trait gets NO Wear/Wield control (equipControl, InventoryTab.tsx:72 returns null off itemType) and is refused by the drag path (`isEquippable`, InventoryTab.tsx:732), so a player can never put an astrolabe in use - the same state the flag's own doc-comment was written for ("nothing in the app equips a loose crystal, so the equip test hid that clause outright rather than qualifying it", situationalBonuses.ts:79-87). The printed requirement (trained in Survival, held in two hands) stays stated in `when`, so the clause qualifies itself instead of going dark. The six sibling astrolabes carry their star in the CODE table and are dark for the same reason - see CROSS-FILE GAPS.

findings.note: The star lives on the item record's own `situational` field (the data twin of FEAT_SITUATIONAL), so no src/ file moves. Survival is the printed REQUIREMENT, carried in `when`; it is not the bonus's target.

backfillRows.why: AoN feat-5730 (Breath of the Dragon, Player Core 2 pg. 45): "The shape of the breath, the damage type, and the saving throw match those of your draconic exemplar (see above)." The three shipped pickers (breath-shape / breath-damage / breath-save) let a player build a breath no dragon has, and ignored the exemplar they had already chosen. SUPERSEDES the shipped 3-picker effectChoices row: all three of its facts are carried WHOLE into every option's note (shape + damage type + trait + save), which is the only merge the printed sentence permits - re-emitting the three free pickers beside a derived one would re-open exactly the illegal combinations the owner ruling closes (owner 2026-09-10 #55, option A). Derivation needs NO code: `answerFromChoiceFlag` (src/rules/types.ts:2083) resolves the pick from another record's choice flag, and heritages/dragonblood already asks the question under flag `draconicExemplar` (40 options, same lowercase values, stored at featChoices['heritage:dragonblood'] - exactly what choiceFlagAnswer reads at src/rules/build.ts:1978). resolvePick (build.ts:6183) takes the flag over any stored answer and EffectChoicesPicker (src/builder/shared.tsx:4596) hides the now-answered control, so the player answers once on the heritage and the feat follows. Rows are the Draconic Benefactors table (Draconic Codex pg. 206, https://2e.aonprd.com/DraconicBenefactors.aspx) as the owner transcribed it; all 40 of our exemplar values are covered, so the "dragons not in the table" fallback is empty.

findings.note: One field, one row: three pickers collapse to a single exemplar-derived choice. The shape/damage/save facts live in the option NOTES (prose the sheet shows beside the pick) rather than in grants, because Breath of the Dragon's damage, area and save have no numeric carrier on a feat record - the same reason the shipped pickers only carried notes. The new data file scripts/data/draconic-benefactors.json the proposal asks for is NOT written here (scripts/ is outside this chunk) - see CROSS-FILE GAPS; the table itself is in this row, so nothing is lost if the file lands later.
